data.title: 伊什塔尔 · 泳池女王的不对称裁定·「两边不对称……才显女神品味」
data.description: 【夏日泳池·正午】不对称设计的黑白比基尼衬得女王蜂般的身段愈发张扬。伊什塔尔从水里跃出，水花在阳光下炸成金粉，落进躺椅时还在笑——「评、评审结果呢？本女神特意挑的不对称设计……才、才不是穿错了！没品味的人类，这可是美索不达米亚最新的流行！」
data.action: 出水后坐稳在池畔躺椅，一手搭扶手、另一手摊掌邀请评审，湿发贴脸
data.camera: medium shot, seated diagonally in a poolside chair, eye level
data.promptProse: Ishtar sits diagonally in the poolside deck chair just after climbing out, wet black hair resting against one cheek beneath her tiara. Preserve the deliberately mismatched black-and-gold bikini and light red sarong. She rests one hand on the chair arm and lifts the other palm toward the viewer as if inviting a verdict on the design, her red eyes bright above an expectant smirk. Use a medium view with the chair's near arm crossing the lower edge; wet deck tiles lead past the chair toward the pool's farther lane ropes. Strong noon sun picks out droplets on her hair and the metal chair frame. Moving pool reflections brighten the shaded sarong folds, while a short chair shadow and damp footprints connect the seat to the deck.
